description: This file defines an abstract class 'LifecycleSubject' which manages lifecycle observers, handles start and stop sequences, logs the stages, and manages subscriptions for lifecycle events within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: LifecycleSubject
classes.description: Provides lifecycle management, including subscription, start, and stop mechanisms with logging capabilities.

classes.name: LifecycleSubject.OrderedObserver
classes.description: Associates a lifecycle observer with a specific stage, allowing ordered start/stop procedures.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Initiates the start sequence for all subscribed observers, organized by stages, with cancellation and exception handling.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Initiates the stop sequence for all started observers in reverse order with cancellation and exception handling.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to a specified lifecycle stage.
